notes.title: THE SENTINEL - STEAM DEVLOG #4
notes.content:
Hello there!

We are here with the 4th text-format DevLog of THE SENTINEL!

If you follow our social media accounts you will see other development processes and game clips/screenshots as well. These DevLogs will be Steam only!

Also, do not forget to join our Discord server!

CONCEPT ARTS

This week, we're doing something different!
Below, you can see two concept artworks created by our concept artist, Göksu İpek.

The first concept belongs to a special item called the "Sound Toy". This item is one of the tools players can use to create noise and distract others.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42690959/b5dbb52cb8ed48c0b83114f592cc6518d2a26e00.png

The second concept features a character that the player encounters during the game.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42690959/5ce2ea0a321723bab05bbecc74b9dcdedde21a4f.png

AND..

That's it for this week. Hope you are satisfied with what you've seen. We will keep posting regular DevLogs.

Until next time!

Aquila Games Team

notes.title: THE SENTINEL - STEAM DEVLOG #3
notes.content:
Hello!

We are here with the third text-format DevLog of THE SENTINEL!

If you follow our social media accounts you will see other development processes and game clips/screenshots as well. These DevLogs will be Steam only!

Also, do not forget to join our Discord server!

NEW SCREENSHOT

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42690959/b9894b5b7490a589cb0ea98c7e5539859d49e495.png

MECHANIC OF THE WEEK: FOCUS

With so many enemies in THE SENTINEL, our players may find it a bit difficult to maintain control. For this reason, we have added a focus system to the game, which allows players to see the location of enemies behind walls. This feature can be used as long as the focus bar is full. You need to consume antidote or blue herb to replenish the focus.

The focus feature can be boosted with special items and this allows you to see the collectible items around you.

WATCH THE CLIP OF THIS MECHANIC

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42690959/fbff479e28f93cc9636f6991b972c8706a0ec45a.gif

Hello!

If you follow our social media accounts you will see other development processes and game clips/screenshots as well. These DevLogs will be Steam only!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42690959/0b457acd141adf9de60489f5c1829082d5718f0c.png

MECHANIC OF THE WEEK: LEVER GATES

Lever gates are another kind of gate you can encounter but since gate types are randomized you might never encounter this type!

To open lever gates you need to find and activate all the levers scattered around, levers themselves deactivate after some time so you need to be quick

Watch the clip of this mechanic

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42690959/a0f293931f5456da4b012e94927ee20450e283c0.png

notes.title: THE SENTINEL - Announcement & New Artwork
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690959/5d30e614a937d3b0503b14320b7b20ef0b772198.png

Hello there!

We’ve officially changed the name of The Sentinel Remake to THE SENTINEL. Check out our updated Steam page for all the latest details by clicking here.

We're going to share more updates and details with you very soon, including some deep gameplay insights. We're aware that old trailers and posts were not clear about what kind of game THE SENTINEL is. So we'll focus on that.

THE SENTINEL's playtests are about to begin and we're so excited to see the end of the tunnel! We just want you to wait a little longer, more updates to come very soon.

Here is the new artworks for THE SENTINEL:
